categories.name: build
categories.evidence: ci/test/02_run_container.py is modified to create deterministic Docker networks and isolate container IP spaces.
categories.rationale: Prevents IP address collisions when running multiple local CI container jobs simultaneously. According to the problem description, containers currently share static IP addresses for bind tests, blocking developers from running concurrent local CI jobs.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label, but the changes to functional test files merely follow from the CI container network changes to read IPs from environment variables.
categories.rationale: The functional test edits are follow-up adjustments to read environment variables rather than changes to the test runner or core test machinery.
